title: Pets
intro: Pets are summonable companions obtained from specific raid bosses across the world. When summoned, each pet provides **passive buffs** that persist as long as it remains active. Pets can be upgraded progressively — the table below shows **max level** bonus values.

howItWorks.title: Controlling Your Pet to Attack

figure.alt: Pet Attack action button in the Actions panel
figure.caption: Pet Attack action — drag this from your Actions panel into your shortcut bar.

steps: Play as a **Summoner** class (or party with one) — only Summoners can use regular Pets.
Learn and **summon** a regular Pet from your Summoner skill list.
Open your **Actions** panel and locate the **Pet Attack** action.
**Drag** the Pet Attack action into your shortcut bar alongside your regular skills.
Select a target, then press the **Pet Attack** shortcut to command your pet to attack it.

infoBoxes.label: Choosing Your Pet
infoBoxes.body: Pick pets that complement your build — **P.Atk / Crit Dmg** pets for physical DPS, **M.Atk / M.Crit Power** for mages, **P.Def / Max HP** for tanks, and **M.Def / Max CP** for support. Higher-tier pets from harder raid bosses provide significantly larger bonuses.

infoBoxes.label: Giran Harbor Macro Trick
infoBoxes.body: Create a **macro** that fires the Pet Attack action on a toggle, then drop the macro into your shortcut bar. Activate it during **Giran Harbor** events and your pet will automatically attack your current target — no extra keypresses needed.
